questions.question: Can a mulligan ranker trained on paired keep-vs-mulligan branch outcomes beat pseudo-oracle and behavior-outcome mulligan rankers?
questions.next_test: Train a small value/ranker on rev0028 pairs, then run the same-shell mulligan gate.

questions.question: How many rollouts per opening branch are needed before keep-vs-mulligan deltas become stable?
questions.next_test: Repeat a small subset with 4-16 branch rollouts per opening.

questions.question: Do 20-life and 40-life games produce different mulligan branch values for Force/Jace/Overlord-heavy hands?
questions.next_test: Aggregate paired deltas by life total and hand composition.

questions.question: Can deterministic no-choice segments between DecisionFrames be batched in C++ without leaking hidden information?
questions.next_test: Instrument segment boundaries and fingerprint before/after states.

questions.question: Which deck constructions are most sensitive to mulligan policy quality?
questions.next_test: Run paired counterfactual probes over MAP-Elites deck shells.

questions.question: Can the same paired-branch idea be applied to gameplay decisions, not just mulligans?
questions.next_test: At selected DecisionFrames, branch on top two legal actions and roll forward under fixed seeds.
